PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?point ?p ?o WHERE {
  ?point brick:isPointOf ?o .
  FILTER(strstarts(str(?point), "https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#"))
  ?point rdf:type ?t .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(str(?t)), "temperature"))
}
LIMIT 5

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?point WHERE {
  ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor .
  ?s brick:isPointOf ?point .
}
LIMIT 5

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?x rdf:type ?t } LIMIT 60

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?zlabel ?seriesId WHERE {
  ?sensor a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor .
  ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zlabel .
  ?point2 ref:hasTimeseriesId ?seriesId .
  ?point2 brick:hasInput ?zone .
}
LIMIT 20

SELECT ?z ?zlabel ?node ?tsid WHERE {
  ?sensor a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor .
  ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference ?node .
  ?node ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?pof brick:feeds ?z .
  ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?pof .
  ?z rdfs:label ?zlabel .
}
